title: A mouse button stays held in a pane when decade loses its release
body:
decade forwards pointer buttons to the focused client in `State::forward_button`. In two places decade drops a release after the press already reached a client. The client then treats the button as still down.

- `State::pointer_left` handles the viewer's `PointerLeft` by clearing hover state and nothing else. If the viewer loses the pointer while a button is down, for example through a Hyprland workspace switch, the release goes to another window and decade never sends one. The viewer's held buttons sit in `Viewer::buttons`, and only `viewer_gone` releases them.
- `State::pointer_button` returns early in its `Overlay::Picker` branch for every button but left, and in its `Overlay::Context` branch for every release. A press forwarded before either overlay opened never gets its release.

Seen 2026-11-12. A ghostty pane reported every motion as a drag with button 9 held, SGR code 161. crossterm drops reports for button 9, so coax in that pane received no motion and drew no hover. Pressing and releasing the thumb button over the pane cleared it. Which of the two places lost that release is not known.

## Proposal

- On `PointerLeft`, release each of the viewer's held buttons through `pointer_button`, as `viewer_gone` does.
- Track the buttons forwarded to clients and not yet released. In the picker and context-menu branches, forward the release of such a button instead of dropping it.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/bea5563a
notes.text: Fix in the working tree on `dev`, not committed. `State` has a new field `forwarded`, kept by `forward_button`. The viewer's `PointerLeft` now releases `Viewer::buttons` through `pointer_button` before `pointer_left`. `pointer_button` forwards the release of a button in `forwarded` while the picker or context menu is open. No unit test was added, because both paths are methods on `State` and no test in the crate builds a `State`. Waiting on Jack to try it with the thumb button.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/bea5563a
notes.text: Committed as aac6899 on `dev`, with a `### Changed` entry in `decade/CHANGELOG.md`. The server was restarted on that release build. The issue stays open until Jack confirms the thumb-button case by hand.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/bea5563a
notes.text: Jack reports the bug still happens on the server restarted with aac6899 at 13:38 on 2026-11-12. The two lost-release paths that aac6899 closes are not the cause, or not the only one. No mouse remapper runs, and Hyprland binds no mouse buttons. Not yet known: what starts it, and whether a ghostty outside decade does the same.
